name: phase-mutations
body: The phase arms. `add` refuses when the phase FQN exists (dropping the `remove_node` + re-add upsert in `plan_add_phase_at`), so a phase's task `Contains` edges are never orphaned. `update` preserves the phase's tasks and applies Satisfies/Gates with set-semantics by reusing `link_phase_edges` (and the gate cycle check). `rm` requires `--force` when the phase has tasks.
